label: LIVE
template_note: evaluator-only; never sent to the model

accepted: All objects are moved to a fixed horizontal line at y=120, starting at x=80 with 12px gaps.
Objects are arranged horizontally at a canvas-relative height (120/700 of canvas.h), with left margin (80/1400 of canvas.w) and gap (12/1400 of canvas.w).
The topmost object defines a baseline: baseline_y = topmost.y - 2*topmost.h; baseline_x = 2/3*baseline_y; gap = 0.1*baseline_y; objects flow right from there.
The first object anchors the layout: y=120 fixed, start_x = first.x + 1.4*first.w, gap=12 fixed.
